name: Doors to Damnation (CR 9)
body:
A soldier guarded this door against overwhelming forces and cursed the invaders with his dying breath when he finally fell.

XP 6,400; LN persistent haunt (a door); Caster Level 9th; Notice Perception DC 16 (to notice words written in blood appearing on the threshold); hp 40; Trigger proximity (passing through the door); Reset 1 day

EFFECT

When this haunt is triggered, place a major curse on the first creature passing through the door each round (DC 19), bestowing a -6 penalty to that character’s most important ability score (GM’s choice).

DESTRUCTION

Both the doorway and the room it opens into must be collapsed. Razing the whole building to the ground or collapsing the cellars below could work as well.
